tooltips.slug: Stable, globally-unique URL slug for this tenant. Used to build per-tenant subdomains such as guest.<slug>.<gitops-domain>. Format: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (e.g. "b2b", "clinica").
tooltips.language: Default language for this tenant. Applied to server-generated text (e.g. tracking event names) and set as the initial preference of users added to the tenant. Empty = instance default.
tooltips.timeZone: Default time zone for this tenant. Set as the initial preference of users added to the tenant. Empty = instance default.
